I had predicted its gradient would match candidate 1 bit for bit; it does not, it differs at about the 1e-10 level, cause unknown. The timing is within the spread of the merged-RHS runs (22.495, 22.423 and now 22.361 s), so I'm not claiming it is faster. Only D=1, carrier batch 1, k=1, the "assemble" scope and grouped components are exercised by the benchmark; the other cases are untested.
